description: This file contains functions for code generation, device options sanitization, signal mapping, keyboard modifier conversions, and click options for Playwright's code generator, specifically tailored for the language.ts module in Playwright's codegen server.

methods.name: generateCode
methods.description: Generates code text from actions using a language generator and options, returning header, footer, action texts, and combined text.

methods.name: generateActionText
methods.description: Creates a string representation of an action, optionally including an auto-generated expect action if preconditionSelector is present.

methods.name: sanitizeDeviceOptions
methods.description: Removes properties from device options that match the device descriptor, returning sanitized options.

methods.name: toSignalMap
methods.description: Maps signals in an action to specific signal types: popup, download, dialog.

methods.name: toKeyboardModifiers
methods.description: Converts a bitmask of modifiers into an array of modifier strings.

methods.name: fromKeyboardModifiers
methods.description: Converts an array of modifier strings into a bitmask number.

methods.name: toClickOptionsForSourceCode
methods.description: Creates mouse click options for source code generation based on a click action.
